method: Recalculated Excel COM Value2 captured with exact IEEE-754 bits, displayed text and cell format. Quantity rules run in the JV BOM engine; supported line-cost amounts use exact rational BigInt arithmetic. EXACT means exact equality to the Excel binary64 rational. DISPLAY_MATCH means the exact engine result and Excel Value2 render identically under that cell’s recorded NumberFormat; both exact values are retained and the classification does not imply numerical equality.
